item.title: Zoho Projects
item.description:
Automate repetitive project management tasks, streamline workflows, and track progress effortlessly to deliver faster and smarter.
With Zoho Projects automation, you can:

  • Automatically assign tasks to the right team members based on skills or workload
  • Set up recurring tasks and milestones to save time
  • Track every stage of your project timeline in real time
  • Get instant alerts on task updates, comments, and deadline changes
  • Automate reminders, follow-ups, and dependency updates
  • Generate detailed project reports without manual effort

By connecting tasks, teams, and timelines, you can ensure accurate planning, faster execution, and seamless project delivery.
Spend less time on admin work and more time focusing on delivering projects that drive results.

item.title: Zoho SalesIQ
item.description:
Engage website visitors, capture leads, and provide instant support with Zoho SalesIQ.
With Zoho SalesIQ, you can:

  • Track and identify visitors in real time on your website or app
  • Initiate live chats based on visitor activity or location
  • Use intelligent bots to qualify leads and answer common questions 24/7
  • Segment visitors and route chats to the right sales or support team
  • Integrate with CRM to log visitor interactions automatically
  • Get detailed reports on visitor engagement and chat performance

By combining live chat, visitor tracking, and automation, you can convert more prospects, deliver better customer experiences, and grow your sales pipeline efficiently.

item.title: Zoho Mail
item.description:
Experience secure, ad-free, and professional email hosting with Zoho Mail.
With Zoho Mail, you can:

  • Host your business email on a custom domain
  • Enjoy an ad-free, clean, and fast interface
  • Access emails seamlessly across web, mobile, and desktop apps
  • Use advanced search to find messages instantly
  • Collaborate with your team using shared mailboxes, tasks, and notes
  • Protect your data with enterprise-grade security and encryption
  • Integrate with Zoho apps and popular third-party tools for streamlined workflows

Zoho Mail ensures reliable communication for your business while maintaining top-notch privacy and security.

item.title: Zoho Books
item.description:
Simplify your accounting and stay on top of your business finances with Zoho Books.
With Zoho Books, you can:

  • Create and send professional invoices in minutes
  • Track income, expenses, and taxes automatically
  • Manage bank transactions with real-time bank feeds
  • Automate payment reminders and recurring invoices
  • Generate GST-compliant reports and file returns easily
  • Collaborate with accountants and team members securely
  • Integrate with Zoho apps and third-party platforms for smooth workflows

Whether you’re a freelancer, small business, or growing enterprise, Zoho Books helps you maintain accurate financial records, save time, and make informed business decisions.

item.title: Zoho Show
item.description:
Create, collaborate, and present stunning presentations with Zoho Show.
With Zoho Show, you can:

  • Design professional slides with customizable templates and themes
  • Collaborate with your team in real-time from anywhere
  • Import and edit PowerPoint files without formatting issues
  • Embed charts, tables, and multimedia for engaging storytelling
  • Broadcast presentations online to remote audiences
  • Control your slides from your mobile device during live sessions
  • Integrate with Zoho apps and external platforms like YouTube and Unsplash

Whether you’re pitching to clients, training employees, or presenting ideas, Zoho Show makes it easy to deliver impactful presentations.

item.title: Zoho Desk
item.description:
Deliver exceptional customer service across email, live chat, phone, social media, and more — all from one unified platform.
With Zoho Desk, your support teams can:

  • Manage tickets from multiple channels in a single interface
  • View complete customer history and past interactions instantly
  • Automate ticket assignments, escalations, and follow-ups
  • Use AI-powered suggestions to respond faster and smarter
  • Track team performance with advanced analytics and dashboards
  • Provide self-service options via a knowledge base, FAQs, and community forums

By streamlining customer service processes and integrating with other Zoho apps, you can resolve issues faster, boost customer satisfaction, and build long-term relationships.

item.title: Zoho Cliq
item.description:
Streamline your team communication and collaboration with Zoho Cliq.
With Zoho Cliq, you can:

  • Chat with individuals or groups in real-time
  • Organize conversations with channels for teams, projects, or topics
  • Make audio and video calls directly from the app
  • Share files, images, and documents instantly
  • Integrate with Zoho apps and third-party tools for seamless workflows
  • Automate repetitive tasks using bots and custom commands
  • Access chats and data from desktop or mobile anytime

Whether your team works in the office or remotely, Zoho Cliq keeps everyone connected, informed, and productive.

item.title: Zoho Expense
item.description:
Streamline expense reporting and gain complete control over your business spending with Zoho Expense.
With Zoho Expense, you can:

  • Capture receipts instantly using mobile or web upload
  • Automatically extract expense details with OCR technology
  • Set spending limits and enforce company expense policies
  • Track mileage with GPS-based distance calculation
  • Automate multi-level expense approvals
  • Generate detailed expense reports for better cost control
  • Integrate seamlessly with accounting, HR, and travel management tools

From small purchases to large travel budgets, Zoho Expense helps you save time, prevent overspending, and ensure compliance with your financial policies.

item.title: Zoho Inventory
item.description:
Efficiently manage your stock, orders, and warehouses with Zoho Inventory.
With Zoho Inventory, you can:

  • Track stock levels in real time across multiple warehouses
  • Manage sales and purchase orders with ease
  • Automate reordering to prevent stockouts or overstocking
  • Integrate with popular e-commerce platforms like Amazon, eBay, and Shopify
  • Sync inventory data with accounting and CRM tools
  • Generate barcode labels for quick product identification
  • Access powerful reports to analyze sales trends and product performance

Whether you’re running a retail store, online shop, or wholesale business, Zoho Inventory ensures you have the right products in the right place at the right time.

item.title: Zoho CRM
item.description:
Harness the power of data to drive your sales strategy with Zoho CRM Analytics & Insights.
With Zoho CRM, you can:

  • Monitor lead generation, conversion rates, and deal progress in real time
  • Track sales pipelines, forecast revenue, and identify top-performing products
  • Access AI-powered dashboards for predictive sales insights
  • Segment customers based on purchase behavior and engagement history
  • Analyze sales team performance to improve productivity
  • Spot bottlenecks and optimize every stage of the customer journey

From prospecting to closing, Zoho CRM’s analytics ensure every decision is backed by actionable insights.
